# ULearn Sync: downloads new lecture PDFs and slides from ULearn into OneDrive course folders. No password is stored in this flow.
@@regionColor: 'Swatch7'
**REGION 1. Setup 
SET DownloadsFolder TO $'''C:\\Users\\user\\Downloads'''
SET BaseFolder TO $'''C:\\Users\\user\\OneDrive - Universiti Teknologi PETRONAS\\ULearn Sync'''
SET LogFile TO $'''%BaseFolder%\\_log\\download_log.csv'''
SET ErrorLog TO $'''%BaseFolder%\\_log\\error_log.txt'''
SET NewCount TO 0
SET NewFileList TO $'''-'''
SET ErrorCount TO 0
DateTime.GetCurrentDateTime.Local DateTimeFormat: DateTime.DateTimeFormat.DateAndTime CurrentDateTime=> CurrentDateTime
Text.ConvertDateTimeToText.FromCustomDateTime DateTime: CurrentDateTime CustomFormat: $'''yyyy-MM-dd''' Result=> Today
# Load the download log so files already saved are skipped.
IF (File.IfFile.Exists File: LogFile) THEN
    File.ReadTextFromFile.ReadText File: LogFile Encoding: File.TextFileEncoding.UTF8 Content=> LogText
ELSE
    File.WriteText File: LogFile TextToWrite: $'''Date,FileID,Course,FileName''' AppendNewLine: True IfFileExists: File.IfFileExists.Append Encoding: File.FileEncoding.UTF8
    SET LongText TO $'''Date,FileID,Course,FileName'''
END
**ENDREGION
@@regionColor: 'Swatch5'
**REGION Log In ti Ulearn
# Uses the existing Microsoft sign-in. If Microsoft asks for a password or phone approval, the user completes it.
WebAutomation.LaunchChrome.LaunchChrome Url: $'''https://ulearn.utp.edu.my/my/''' WindowState: WebAutomation.BrowserWindowState.Maximized ClearCache: False ClearCookies: False WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60 Timeout: 60 PiPUserDataFolderMode: WebAutomation.PiPUserDataFolderModeEnum.AutomaticProfile TargetDesktop: $'''{\"DisplayName\":\"Local computer\",\"Route\":{\"ServerType\":\"Local\",\"ServerAddress\":\"\"},\"DesktopType\":\"local\"}''' BrowserInstance=> Browser
@@CustomNote: 'Log in'
IF (WebAutomation.IfWebPageContains.WebPageContainsElement BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'https://ulearn.utp.edu.my/login/index.php\'']['Anchor \'Log in using your UTP ID\'']) THEN
    WebAutomation.Click.Click BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'https://ulearn.utp.edu.my/login/index.php\'']['Anchor \'Log in using your UTP ID\' 2'] ClickType: WebAutomation.ClickType.LeftClick MouseClick: True WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60 MousePositionRelativeToElement: WebAutomation.RectangleEdgePoint.MiddleCenter OffsetX: 0 OffsetY: 0
    WAIT 2
    IF (WebAutomation.IfWebPageContains.WebPageContainsElement BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... rosoft.com\'']['Anchor \'Use a different account\'']) THEN
        WebAutomation.Click.Click BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... rosoft.com\'']['Anchor \'Use a different account\' 2'] ClickType: WebAutomation.ClickType.LeftClick MouseClick: True WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60 MousePositionRelativeToElement: WebAutomation.RectangleEdgePoint.MiddleCenter OffsetX: 0 OffsetY: 0
        IF (WebAutomation.IfWebPageContains.WebPageContainsElement BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... b3iY_pCtw2\'']['Div \'Pick an account\'']) THEN
            WebAutomation.Click.Click BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... b3iY_pCtw2\'']['Small \'adrianna_22011496@utp.edu.my\''] ClickType: WebAutomation.ClickType.LeftClick MouseClick: True WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60 MousePositionRelativeToElement: WebAutomation.RectangleEdgePoint.MiddleCenter OffsetX: 0 OffsetY: 0
        END
    END
END
IF (WebAutomation.IfWebPageContains.WebPageDoesNotContainText BrowserInstance: Browser Text: $'''Dashboard''') THEN
    Display.ShowMessageDialog.ShowMessage Title: $'''Ulearn Sync ''' Message: $'''Please finish signing in to Microsoft in Chrome, then click OK''' Icon: Display.Icon.None Buttons: Display.Buttons.OK DefaultButton: Display.DefaultButton.Button1 IsTopMost: False ButtonPressed=> ButtonPressed
END
WAIT (WebAutomation.WaitForWebPageContent.WebPageToContainText BrowserInstance: Browser Text: $'''Dashboard''') FOR 60
**ENDREGION
@@regionColor: 'Swatch1'
**REGION Get Course List
WebAutomation.GoToWebPage.GoToWebPage BrowserInstance: Browser Url: $'''https://ulearn.utp.edu.my/my/courses.php''' WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60
WAIT 5
# Lists every file in the course from Moodle's file index page.
WebAutomation.ExecuteJavascript BrowserInstance: Browser Javascript: $'''function ExecuteScript() {
  var seen = {};
  var lines = [];
  var links = document.querySelectorAll(\'a[href*=\"/course/view.php?id=\"]\');
  for (var i = 0; i < links.length; i++) {
    var a = links[i];
    var id = a.href.split(\'id=\')[1].split(\'&\')[0];
    var name = a.textContent.replace(/\\s+/g, \' \').trim();
    var m = name.match(/[A-Z]{3}\\d{4}.*/);
    if (m) { name = m[0]; }
    name = name.replace(/\\//g, \'-\').replace(/:/g, \' \').replace(/[\\\\*?\"<>|]/g, \'\').trim();
    if (!seen[id] && name !== \'\') {
      seen[id] = true;
      lines.push(id + \'|\' + name);
    }
  }
    return lines.join(\'\\r\\n\');
}''' Result=> CourseResult
Text.SplitText.Split Text: CourseResult StandardDelimiter: Text.StandardDelimiter.NewLine DelimiterTimes: 1 Result=> CourseLines
**ENDREGION
@@regionColor: 'Swatch2'
**REGION Download and Organise files
LOOP FOREACH CourseLine IN CourseLines
    Text.SplitText.SplitWithDelimiter Text: CourseLine CustomDelimiter: $'''|''' IsRegEx: False Result=> CourseParts
    SET CourseID TO CourseParts[0]
    SET CourseName TO CourseParts[1]
    IF (Folder.IfFolderExists.DoesNotExist Path: $'''%BaseFolder%\\%CourseName%''') THEN
        Folder.Create FolderPath: BaseFolder FolderName: CourseName Folder=> NewFolder
        SET CourseFolder TO $'''%BaseFolder%\\%CourseName%'''
    END
    WebAutomation.GoToWebPage.GoToWebPage BrowserInstance: Browser Url: $'''https://ulearn.utp.edu.my/mod/resource/index.php?id=%CourseID%''' WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60
    WAIT 2
    WebAutomation.ExecuteJavascript BrowserInstance: Browser Javascript: $'''function ExecuteScript() {
  var seen = {};
  var lines = [];
  var links = document.querySelectorAll(\'a[href*=\"/mod/resource/view.php?id=\"]\');
  for (var i = 0; i < links.length; i++) {
    var a = links[i];
    var id = a.href.split(\'id=\')[1].split(\'&\')[0];
    var name = a.textContent.replace(/\\s+/g, \' \').trim();
    name = name.replace(/\\//g, \'-\').replace(/:/g, \' \').replace(/[\\\\*?\"<>|]/g, \'\').trim();
    if (!seen[id] && name !== \'\') {
      seen[id] = true;
      lines.push(id + \'|\' + name);
    }
  }
  return lines.join(\'\\r\\n\');;
}''' Result=> FileResult
    Text.SplitText.Split Text: FileResult StandardDelimiter: Text.StandardDelimiter.NewLine DelimiterTimes: 1 Result=> FileLines
    LOOP FOREACH FileLine IN FileLines
        IF IsNotEmpty(FileLine) THEN
            Text.SplitText.SplitWithDelimiter Text: FileLine CustomDelimiter: $'''|''' IsRegEx: False Result=> FileParts
            SET FileID TO FileParts[0]
            SET FileName TO FileParts[1]
            # Skip files already in the download log.
            IF NotContains(LogText, $''',%FileID%,''', False) THEN
                # Finds the real file address, skips anything that is not PDF or PowerPoint and forces the download.
                WebAutomation.ExecuteJavascript BrowserInstance: Browser Javascript: $'''function ExecuteScript() {
  var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
  xhr.open(\'HEAD\', \'https://ulearn.utp.edu.my/mod/resource/view.php?id=%FileID%&redirect=1\', false);
  xhr.send();
  var url = xhr.responseURL;
  if (url.indexOf(\'pluginfile.php\') === -1) { return \'ERROR\'; }
  var parts = url.split(\'?\')[0].split(\'/\');
  var fileName = decodeURIComponent(parts[parts.length - 1]);
  var ext = fileName.split(\'.\').pop().toLowerCase();
  var allowed = [\'pdf\', \'ppt\', \'pptx\'];
  if (allowed.indexOf(ext) === -1) { return \'SKIPPED\'; }
  var link = document.createElement(\'a\');
  link.href = url + (url.indexOf(\'?\') > -1 ? \'&\' : \'?\') + \'forcedownload=1\';
  link.download = \'\';
  document.body.appendChild(link);
  link.click();
  link.remove();
  return fileName;
}''' Result=> DownloadedFileName
                IF DownloadedFileName <> $'''SKIPPED''' THEN
                    # Wait up to 60 seconds for the download to finish.
                    SET Tries TO 0
                    LOOP WHILE (Tries) < (60)
                        IF (File.IfFile.Exists File: $'''%DownloadsFolder%\\%DownloadedFileName%''') THEN
                            EXIT LOOP
                        END
                        WAIT 1
                        Variables.IncreaseVariable Value: Tries IncrementValue: 1
                    END
                    WAIT 2
                    IF EndsWith(DownloadedFileName, $'''.pdf''', True) THEN
                        File.Move Files: $'''%DownloadsFolder%\\%DownloadedFileName%''' Destination: CourseFolder IfFileExists: File.IfExists.Overwrite MovedFiles=> MovedFiles
                        File.WriteText File: LogFile TextToWrite: $'''%Today%,%FileID%,\"%CourseName%\",\"%DownloadedFileName%\"''' AppendNewLine: True IfFileExists: File.IfFileExists.Append Encoding: File.FileEncoding.Unicode
                        Variables.IncreaseVariable Value: NewCount IncrementValue: 1
                        SET NewFilesList TO $'''%NewFilesList%• %DownloadedFileName%
'''
                    ELSE
                        # Convert PowerPoint to PDF with the PowerPoint app, then delete the original.
                        File.GetPathPart File: $'''%DownloadsFolder%\\%DownloadedFileName%''' FileNameWithoutExtension=> FileNameNoExtension
                        Scripting.RunPowershellScript.RunScript Script: $'''$in = \"%DownloadsFolder%\\%DownloadedFileName%\"
$out = \"%CourseFolder%\\%FileNameNoExtension%.pdf\"
Unblock-File -Path $in
$ppt = New-Object -ComObject PowerPoint.Application
$pres = $ppt.Presentations.Open($in, -1, 0, 0)
$pres.SaveAs($out, 32)
$pres.Close()
$ppt.Quit()
[System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::ReleaseComObject($pres) | Out-Null
[System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::ReleaseComObject($ppt) | Out-Null
[GC]::Collect()
[GC]::WaitForPendingFinalizers()
Write-Output \"OK\"''' ScriptOutput=> PowershellOutput ScriptError=> ScriptError
                        ON ERROR

                        END
                        WAIT 2
                        IF Contains(PowershellOutput, $'''OK''', False) THEN
                            File.Delete Files: $'''%DownloadsFolder%\\%DownloadedFileName%'''
                            File.WriteText File: LogFile TextToWrite: $'''%Today%,%FileID%,\"%CourseName%\",\"%FileNameNoExtension%.pdf\"''' AppendNewLine: True IfFileExists: File.IfFileExists.Append Encoding: File.FileEncoding.UTF8
                            Variables.IncreaseVariable Value: NewCount IncrementValue: 1
                            SET NewFilesList TO $'''%NewFilesList%• %FileNameNoExtension%.pdf


'''
                        END
                    END
                END
            END
        END
    END
END
**ENDREGION

Display.ShowMessageDialog.ShowMessageWithTimeout Title: $'''Ulearn Sync''' Message: $'''%NewCount% new files downloaded.
%ErrorCount% problems (see error_log.txt).
%NewFilesList%''' Icon: Display.Icon.None Buttons: Display.Buttons.OK DefaultButton: Display.DefaultButton.Button1 IsTopMost: False Timeout: 120 ButtonPressed=> ButtonPressed2
**ENDREGION
